  PROBLEM: `unblock_wait_max_hours()` writes its invalid-value log line to stdout, so the `$(unblock_wait_max_hours)` callers at lines 1260 and 1450 capture the log text plus the number.
  WHY: The `-lt` test at line 1260 and the arithmetic at line 1450 break, so holds expire wrongly or the wait verdict comment is never posted. Source severity is MAJOR from all five reviewers.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:296-306 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `unblock_operator_step_placeholder()` (called at line 1169) does not require the `operator_step` verdict to be the newest round verdict or to belong to the merged fix-up.
  WHY: A later `descope` or other fix-up that merges can pick up an older `operator_step` placeholder and produce a wrong `placeholder_retired` hold. Source severity is MAJOR from all four reviewers.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1255-1258 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `unknown)` hold-check arm returns 0 without comparing the hold's age to `unblock_wait_max_hours`.
  WHY: A permanently unreadable condition leaves the hold open forever, and the max-days expiry never applies. Source severity is MAJOR from all five reviewers.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1172-1183 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A failed `unblock_patch_comment ... || true` after the `placeholder_retired` hold POST leaves the fix-up wait marker open.
  WHY: The next run posts a duplicate hold, and duplicates count toward MAX_HOLDS_PER_ITEM (3) and eventually remove `wait` from the menu. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said NIT (uncommon); the other four said MAJOR. The highest is used. minimax_minimax-m3 added that this path bypasses `decide()`, so the cap does not apply.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:296-306 (prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt:20; prompts/_templates/mode-judge-unblock.txt) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The operator-step placeholder extraction (jq capture at line 302, call at line 1169) needs the exact sentence "Stays off behind `NAME` until the operator step is done.", but the prompt does not require it.
  WHY: If the model words `operator_instructions` differently, the auto-hold is silently skipped and the item resumes immediately. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputed this: the script writes the sentence itself (lines 1529-1531), so the model never writes it.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1210-1220 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The shell never reads `CHECK_TRIAGE_RESOLVED_GATE_ENABLED` before invoking the check-triage resolution gate.
  WHY: Gemini claims the gate runs unconditionally (MAJOR). minimax says the flag is honoured only in `check_triage_resolution.py:560`, so the effect is extra work per issue (NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dropped this because the python helper honours the flag. The highest severity is used.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1251 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `git grep` runs unoptimized across the entire repository.
  WHY: It could exceed time limits on large repositories.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1167-1174 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The operator-step path posts a `placeholder_retired` hold without checking whether the condition is already met.
  WHY: If the person already retired the placeholder or set the variable or secret, the item stays blocked until the next hold scan (UNBLOCK_JUDGE_RETRY_HOURS, 6 hours by default).
